Chapter 3 of Harem Party! A collection of side stories set as a prequel to chapter 2, with our wayward hero running into all sort of buxom women who fall head of heels for him in about five seconds thanks to the spell he cast on himself. Beautiful art, though I miss the demon lord. Bring her back!
